# Brief 01: Market entry

Audience: Alderbrook Foods executive committee.
Decision: approve a phased entry into Vietnam plant-based dairy (initial commitment of $6M, gate at month 24).
Format: 10 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds the five-market comparison used on slides 3 and 4.

## Facts

F1: Plant-based dairy retail sales in 2025 (USD million): Vietnam 210, Thailand 340, Indonesia 290, Philippines 120, Malaysia 150; five-market total 1,110.
F2: Forecast growth 2025-30 (CAGR): Vietnam 14.2%, Thailand 8.1%, Indonesia 9.6%, Philippines 10.3%, Malaysia 7.4%.
F3: Share of the top three brands in 2025: Vietnam 38%, Thailand 61%, Indonesia 55%, Philippines 49%, Malaysia 66%.
F4: Vietnam market path (USD million): 2025 210, 2026 240, 2027 274, 2028 313, 2029 357, 2030 408.
F5: 46% of urban shoppers aged 25 to 40 in Vietnam tried a plant-based milk in the last 12 months; the median premium they accept over dairy is 18%.
F6: Sales channel mix in Vietnam: modern trade 41%, e-commerce 23%, traditional trade 36%.
F7: Entry option A, export only: capex $2M, break-even in year 4, 2030 revenue $22M.
F8: Entry option B, co-manufacturing partner: capex $6M, break-even in year 3, 2030 revenue $48M.
F9: Entry option C, own plant: capex $18M, break-even in year 5, 2030 revenue $85M.
F10: Finished dairy alternatives carry a 15% import tariff in Vietnam; local co-packing avoids it.
F11: Recommended path: option B now, with a gate at month 24 to build a plant if run-rate sales reach $20M.
F12: Launch is possible in month 9 after signing; the first modern-trade listings cover 1,200 stores.
